title: Multiplier rigidity for complex Hénon maps
summary: We investigate the multiplier rigidity problem for polynomial automorphisms of $\mathbf{C}^2$. A first result states that a complex Hénon map of given degree is determined up to finitely many choices by its multiplier spectrum, or more generally by the unstable multipliers of its saddle periodic points. This is the counterpart in this setting of a classical result of McMullen for one-dimensional rational maps.
